**Job Title:** Software Engineer, Agents

**Team:** Engineering

**Location:** Onsite - Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica & West LA)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Salary, Exempt

**Reports To:** Head of Engineering

**About Plug**

Plug is an automotive fintech startup that’s building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Consumers, dealers, and commercial partners trade in, sell, and auction used EVs through a platform built exclusively for electric, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.

Sellers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data-driven pricing and battery state-of-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end-to-end.

Every vehicle Plug acquires is sold through a competitive wholesale auction, where franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from consumers, dealers, and commercial partners.

The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory.

Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated over $150M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners.

Join us as we build the AI-native transaction rails behind the used EV market’s exponential growth. Learn more at plugmotors.com.

**Why Plug**

* You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive.
* You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive.
* You’ll be part of an AI-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level.
* You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces.
* You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes.

**The Opportunity**

Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. We’re looking for someone to join our team and help turn real operational problems into agents that work reliably, working closely with senior engineers as you grow into greater ownership over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build and ship agents and multi-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling, with support from senior engineers on scope and architecture.
* Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them.
* Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible.
* Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them.
* Help monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human-review rates. Learn to identify and fix what breaks, and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time.
* Ship full-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them.
* Contribute to the reusable tools, examples, and short write-ups that help the team build agents faster, growing into helping others adopt these patterns as you build experience.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3+ years of full-time industry software engineering, with experience shipping features to production and supporting them after launch.
* Solid TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed.
* Some hands-on experience with LLM features in production (tool use, retrieval, structured output) or strong interest and aptitude for learning this quickly.
* Familiarity with an agent framework and observability stack (LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse) is a plus; we’re also open to candidates who’ve worked with other tools and can show us what you built.
* Comfortable using agentic coding tools day to day, and curious about building your own tooling around them (skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals) as you grow.
* Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan.
* A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up.
* You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit.
* A proactive mindset in an ambiguous, fast-moving startup. You’re eager to find valuable workflows to automate and ship against them with support from the team.
* BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with document-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance.
* Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products.
* Experience with human-in-the-loop review tools, or with fine-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features.

**ABOUT ROCKET LAB**

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

**SPACE SYSTEMS**

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

**SOFTWARE ENGINEER II**

Rocket Lab Robotics specializes in high-performance robotic systems and precision mechanisms that enable the most ambitious space missions, including NASA's Mars Perseverance Rover and CADRE lunar rovers. Leveraging Mars-proven expertise from Motiv Space Systems, we deliver scalable, flight-proven solutions – such as robotic arms, motion control systems, and solar array drive assemblies (SADAs) – to support planetary exploration, satellite servicing, and national security missions.

As a Software Engineer II based out of Rocket Lab Robotics' office in Pasadena, CA, you will design and build the software that powers our motion control systems in flight and on the ground. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering fundamentals who wants to own the core software of our missions: how our systems communicate, manage data, receive updates, and are operated from the ground. You'll participate in all aspects of software development, from requirements and architecture through implementation, testing, and on-orbit operations. And thanks to Rocket Lab's own launch vehicles and frequent missions, your software will be flying in months, not years. Over time, you'll help shape the software architecture, tools, and practices our whole team relies on.

**WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:**

* Participate in all aspects of software design and development, from requirements definition and architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Design and develop flight and ground software primarily on embedded Linux and Linux desktop platforms, with some Windows, RTOS, and bare-metal projects.
* Build distributed software systems that connect flight computers, spacecraft buses, and ground stations, including communication protocols, networking, and data and file transfer.
* Develop data management capabilities such as storage, file handling, compression, and encryption for systems operating over bandwidth-constrained links.
* Design and implement strategies for deploying and updating software on systems in orbit, from full releases to efficient incremental patches.
* Build ground software applications and GUIs for commanding, telemetry, and data handling.
* Contribute to robotics and motion control software as program needs require.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive unit and integration tests that run within a continuous integration framework and collaborate with hardware-in-the-loop test engineers to verify software on real hardware.
* Participate in code reviews and design reviews such as PDR and CDR, and champion software best practices, coding standards, and sound architecture across the team.
* Collaborate with systems, electrical, and FPGA engineers to define requirements and interfaces.
* Partner with our DevOps team on build, test, and deployment infrastructure.
* Assist with on-orbit flight operations.

**YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or other technical discipline
* 2+ years of professional software development experience
* Proficiency in C++, C, and Python
* Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, operating system concepts, and multithreading and concurrency
* Experience with networking concepts and socket programming (TCP/IP, UDP)
* Strong comfort developing in Linux environments
* Experience working with real hardware, motors, micro-controllers, sensors etc.
* Some experience with embedded software development
* Experience with software testing practices, including unit and integration testing
* U.S. citizenship is required, due to program requirements

**THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:**

* Experience writing software for resource-constrained systems, such as C++ without dynamic memory allocation or the STL
* Familiarity with coding standards such as MISRA C/C++, NASA NPR 7150.2D, or JPL's Power of 10 rules
* Experience with embedded Linux build systems such as Yocto or Buildroot
* Experience with RTOS (FreeRTOS, RTEMS, VxWorks, or similar) or bare-metal development
* Experience building GUIs with frameworks such as Qt, Tcl/Tk, or web-based technologies
* Experience using the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2)
* Experience designing distributed systems or using messaging middleware such as DDS or ZeroMQ
* Familiarity with data compression, encryption, and serialization techniques
* Experience with software update and deployment strategies for remote or embedded systems such as Opkg
* Knowledge of CCSDS standards, including Space Packet Protocol and CFDP
